name: Whole Numbers
source:
it's like one of those stories that takes up half of a sci-fi mag and it keeps going inside of itself and nobody is exactly sure what impulse each other is exploring. "first" contact, tumbling combinations of unknowables, overlaps between impossible things, (anti)-climax

[From [url=https://wasnotwhynot.itch.io/whole-numbers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这就像一个占据了科幻杂志一半的故事，它不断地在自身内部发展，没有人确切地知道彼此正在探索什么冲动。“第一次”接触、不可知事物的翻滚组合、不可能事物之间的重叠、（反）高潮

[来自[url=https://wasnotwhynot.itch.io/whole-numbers]itch.io[/url]]
